description: Get the exact steps to connect a payment stack to Affitor: the install, the checkout metadata snippet, the trackSale snippet and the file it goes in, and the check that proves it works. Use it before writing integration code, instead of guessing the contract. Works offline: it reads a built-in recipe list and calls no API.

framework.description: The app's framework, read from its package.json and folders: next-app (app/ router), next-pages (pages/ router), fastify, express, node, or unknown. It decides which file the sale snippet goes in.

mode.description: How sales reach Affitor. stripe_connect: the brand's connected Stripe account reports sales, so the plan only adds checkout metadata. s2s: your payment webhook calls trackSale. Leave it out for stripe_connect.

provider.description: The payment provider the app checks out with, read from its dependencies. Leave it out for stripe.

name: affitor_get_integration_plan
